links.outcome: Model performance across multiple institutions and organ systems
links.effect: 15 state-of-the-art results across five human systems and six institutions (n = 332,673); supports zero-shot transfer
links.quote: ChatRadio-Valuer achieved 15 state-of-the-art results across five human systems and six institutions in clinical-level events (n = 332,673) through rigorous and full-spectrum assessment, including engineering metrics, clinical validation, and efficiency evaluation.

unlisted_practices: Locally deployed, hospital-hosted fine-tuned LLM for radiology impression generation to preserve privacy

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates ChatRadio-Valuer, an LLM for generating radiology impressions, comparing it against general LLMs and expert radiologists using multi-institutional retrospective data and clinical validation metrics.
